function.name: DllMain
function.description: This function is an entry point to a DLL. It handles process and thread initialization and termination.

parameters.name: hinstDLL
parameters.description: A handle to the DLL module.

parameters.name: fdwReason
parameters.description: The reason the DLL entry-point function is being called.

parameters.name: lpvReserved
parameters.description: If fdwReason is DLL_PROCESS_DETACH, lpvReserved is used to indicate whether the DLL is being unloaded as a result of a call to FreeLibrary and FreeLibraryAndExitThread or the process is terminating.

function.return_type: BOOL, indicates the success or failure. Returns a nonzero value if successful; otherwise, it returns zero.

function.name: get_pixelformat_bpp
function.description: This function retrieves the number of bits per pixel for a given pixel format.

parameters.name: pixelformat
parameters.description: A pointer to the GUID of the pixel format.

parameters.name: bpp
parameters.description: A pointer to a UINT that receives the number of bits per pixel.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: TiffDecoder_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of a TIFF decoder.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: This is an identifier for the interface.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the interface pointer that receives the interface pointer requested in iid.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, the return value is S_OK.

function.name: TiffEncoder_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of a TIFF encoder.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Interface identifier for the encoder instance.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the function stores the output encoder instance.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: JpegDecoder_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of a JPEG decoder.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: This parameter is used to identify the interface that the caller is to use to communicate with the JPEG decoder.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in iid. Upon successful return, *ppv contains the requested interface pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: JpegEncoder_CreateInstance
function.description: This function creates an instance of a JPEG encoder.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: This is an interface identifier that the function uses to create an instance of a specific interface.

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer. The function uses this to return the address of the created instance.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.
